title: Design System: Fyther Store V0.2 Neon Door

display.purpose: Warm editorial statements and product headings.

motion.name: reduced-feedback
motion.purpose: Opacity and color feedback when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Cyan Action
components.description: Primary action for the next clear customer step.
components.css: .button-primary { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid #6eeff2; background: #6eeff2; color: #050608; font: 800 13px Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; }

components.name: Quiet Action
components.description: Secondary command on Night without competing with the primary action.
components.css: .button-ghost { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid rgba(234,251,251,.5); background: transparent; color: #eafbfb; font: 800 13px Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; }

components.name: Commerce Input
components.description: Persistent-label field with accessible inline validation.
components.css: .field-block input { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid rgba(234,251,251,.3); border-radius: 4px; background: #0b0d10; color: #eafbfb; font: 400 16px Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; }

components.name: Category Filter
components.description: Compact live-category selection in the catalog toolbar.
components.css: .filter-pill { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid rgba(234,251,251,.24); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #eafbfb; font: 800 12px Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; }

components.name: Commerce State
components.description: Honest empty, unavailable or unconfigured live-commerce state.

narrative.overview: A warm nocturnal activewear boutique for women, friends and familiar recommendations, balancing expressive editorial scenes with precise live commerce.

rules.name: Night First
rules.body: Night carries the experience; Cyan directs action and Pink punctuates small selected moments.

rules.name: Official Mark
rules.body: Use the supplied logo assets and never recreate the Fyther wordmark as text.

rules.name: Commerce Truth
rules.body: Products, prices, stock, payments, orders and tracking come only from BilBildin.

rules.name: Motion With Care
rules.body: Use transform and opacity, keep control feedback brief and fully respect reduced motion.

dos: Use inviting Spanish centered on personal rhythm and feeling well.
Keep operational panels at 8px radius or less.
donts: Do not add gradients, nested cards or fake commercial data.
Do not use the retired green palette or aggressive performance language.
Do not expose integration details in customer-facing states.
